Explorers.BrainInfo: Explorers Society represents individuals with a diverse range of cognitive abilities and a spirit of curiosity and adventure. While IQ scores may vary widely within this society, members share a common passion for exploration, learning, and discovery. They thrive in environments that encourage experimentation and intellectual curiosity.

Strivers.BrainInfo: Strivers Society consists of determined individuals with solid cognitive abilities and a persistent work ethic. With IQs ranging from 90 to 110, members of this society exhibit resilience, resourcefulness, and a strong desire for self-improvement. They excel in overcoming challenges and achieving success through perseverance and dedication.

Elites.BrainInfo: Elites Society encompasses individuals with above-average intelligence and a keen ability to adapt to complex situations. With IQs ranging from 110 to 130, members of this society possess strong analytical skills, strategic thinking, and a drive for continuous improvement. They often occupy leadership positions and excel in navigating competitive environments.

Mavericks.BrainInfo: Mavericks Society consists of highly intelligent individuals who thrive on independent thinking and unconventional approaches. With IQs ranging from 130 to 150, members of this society are known for their boldness, ingenuity, and willingness to challenge the status quo. They excel in pushing boundaries and pioneering new ideas across diverse domains.

Titans.BrainInfo: Titans Society comprises individuals with exceptionally high cognitive abilities, often demonstrating genius-level intellect. Members of this elite group possess unmatched problem-solving skills and exhibit extraordinary creativity. Their minds operate at unparalleled levels of complexity, making them visionary leaders and innovators in various fields.

questions.question: What is the Tournament Mode?
questions.answer: The tournament mode is a fun game where you answer questions on different topics to win points and see how you compare with others.

questions.question: Who Can Play?
questions.answer: To join the tournament mode, you need to have: a 2-day quiz streak, OR complete 3 quizzes under 30 minutes, OR complete 6 quizzes in a day, OR achieve an RQM score greater than 42 in 2 quizzes in a day. This ensures you're ready to compete!

questions.question: When Can I register for the tournament?
questions.answer: You can register for the tournament between Monday and Friday, until 11 PM. Don't worry, you'll have plenty of time to get ready.

questions.question: How to Choose Topics?
questions.answer: When signing up, you will pick 3 categories from a list like Sports, Technology, Health, and more. Plus, an additional category named Current Affairs is selected automatically.

questions.question: When Does the Tournament Happen?
questions.answer: The tournament takes place on Saturday and Sunday. You can play anytime during these two days, so it is really flexible.

questions.question: How Does the Quiz Work?
questions.answer: You will have to answer 5 questions from 3 categories you picked, plus the Current Affairs category and for each category you will get 2 attempts in which we will take the best of both the attempts. But be quick – you have only 50 seconds for each set of questions!

questions.question: How Can I See My Score and Ranking?
questions.answer: After you finish, your score and ranking will show up on a special leaderboard in tournament tab. You can see how well you did compared to other players right away.

questions.question: How can I earn badges in a tournament?
questions.answer: You can earn badges based on your performance in the tournament. Participants who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd overall will receive Hall of Fame badges. In specific categories, those who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd will receive Ace, Pro, and Champ badges, respectively. Additionally, participants who finish in the top 5%, 10%, and 25% of the tournament leaderboard will receive corresponding badges. All other participants will be awarded the Quiz Warrior badge. These badges will be displayed on your profile page and the main leaderboard of Rapid Recap.

questions.question: Where Do the Questions Come From?
questions.answer: The quiz questions will come from the 3 categories you have selected when registering for tournament, plus the Current Affairs category (2 attempts for each category), which are about things that happened worldwide in the past week. This keeps everything fresh and exciting!

questions.question: Why Should I Play?
questions.answer: It is a great way to learn new things, challenge yourself, and compete with others. Plus, it is fun to see your name rise on the leaderboard!

page1.title: Welcome to Rapid Recap Tournament!
page1.content1: Welcome to the exciting world of Rapid Recap Tournament!
page1.content2: This weekend event is your chance to showcase your knowledge, compete with others, and have a blast while learning new things.
page1.content3: Get ready for a thrilling quiz experience that covers various categories and keeps you up-to-date with current affairs!

page2.title: Eligibility and Registration
page2.content1: To join the tournament mode, you need to have: a 2-day quiz streak, OR complete 3 quizzes under 30 minutes, OR complete 6 quizzes in a day, OR achieve an RQM score greater than 42 in 2 quizzes in a day. This ensures you're ready to compete!. It's like building your quiz power!
page2.content2: Registration is open from Monday to Friday until 11 PM. Don't miss your chance to enter the arena of knowledge!
page2.content3: During registration, you'll choose 3 categories out of 15 exciting options. Plus, everyone gets to tackle the 'Current Affairs' category!

page3.title: Tournament Structure
page3.content1: The big event happens every Saturday and Sunday. You can participate at any time during these two days!
page3.content2: You'll face 5 questions from each of your chosen categories, plus 5 from Current Affairs. There will be 2 attempts for each category. That's a total of 40 brain-teasing questions!
page3.content3: The Current Affairs questions come about global events from the last 5 days, keeping you in the loop!

page4.title: Quiz Challenge
page4.content1: Here's where the adrenaline kicks in: you have just 50 seconds to answer 5 questions. It's a true test of speed and knowledge!
page4.content2: Don't stress if you can't answer them all. The goal is to have fun and learn something new with every quiz.
page4.content3: Remember, practice makes perfect. The more you play, the better you'll get at tackling these rapid-fire questions!

page5.title: Scoring and Leaderboard
page5.content1: After completing the quiz, you'll see how you stack up against other players on our real-time leaderboard.
page5.content2: Your ranking is based on your total RQM (Rapid Quiz Master) score, which combines your performance across all categories.
page5.content3: The leaderboard updates instantly, so you'll always know where you stand in the heat of the competition!

page6.title: Earn Badges for you!
page6.content1: Showcase your skills by earning badges in the Rapid Recap Tournament! Participants who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd overall will receive Hall of Fame badges, while category-specific top performers will earn Ace, Pro, and Champ badges.
page6.content2: Players in the top 5%, 10%, or 25% of the leaderboard will earn corresponding badges, and all other participants will receive the Quiz Warrior badge for their efforts.
page6.content3: Your badges will be displayed on your profile page and the main leaderboard, celebrating your accomplishments for all to see!

page7.title: Final Tips and Good Luck!
page7.content1: Stay curious and keep learning! The tournament is designed to be both fun and educational.
page7.content2: Don't forget to brush up on current affairs. It might give you the edge you need to climb the leaderboard!
page7.content3: Most importantly, enjoy the experience. Whether you're aiming for the top spot or just having fun, you're part of an epic quest for knowledge!
page7.content4: Good luck, Rapid Recapper! May your mind be quick and your answers true! 🏆🎉

meta.title: Player's Manual | Rapid Recap
meta.description: Learn how to play and master Rapid Recap with our comprehensive player's manual.

reading-time.explanation: Our reading time is carefully calibrated for optimal information absorption. 2-4 minutes provides enough time to grasp key concepts while maintaining engagement. This duration has been proven to maximize retention and quiz performance.

quiz-time.text: Quiz Time: 50 seconds for optimal performance
quiz-time.explanation: The 50-second time limit is based on cognitive science research. This duration creates the perfect balance between pressure and performance, keeping you engaged while allowing sufficient time for thoughtful answers. This timing has been shown to improve both accuracy and learning retention.

questions.explanation: Each quiz contains 5 carefully crafted questions that test your understanding of key concepts. This number is optimized for quick engagement while providing comprehensive coverage of the article content.

indian-mythology.explanation: Experience questions through the lens of Indian mythology. Complex concepts are explained using analogies from ancient Indian epics and legends.

mystic-world.explanation: Enter a world of magic and superheroes! Articles are reimagined using elements from Harry Potter, Marvel, and DC universes.

space-theme.explanation: Transform your quiz experience into an interstellar journey. Questions are rewritten with cosmic analogies and space-themed contexts while maintaining the original information.

greek-mythology.explanation: Questions are reimagined through classical Greek mythology, where modern concepts meet ancient wisdom and legendary tales.

bible-stories.explanation: Experience current events through biblical narratives! Articles are retold using well-known stories from the Bible as metaphors.

sci-fi-adventure.explanation: Enter a futuristic universe! Stories are reimagined using elements from Star Wars, Star Trek, and other sci-fi worlds.

correct-answers.explanation: Each correct answer contributes to your base RQM score. The system uses advanced algorithms to weight questions based on difficulty.

perfect-score.explanation: Achieve a perfect score to earn a 20% boost to your RQM. This significant bonus rewards mastery and encourages thorough understanding.

near-perfect.explanation: Missing just one question still earns you a 10% bonus, encouraging consistency and rewarding strong performance.

base-time.explanation: The 15-second baseline for each question is carefully calculated to allow for reading, processing, and answering.

speed-bonus.explanation: Quick answers can earn up to double points! The speed multiplier scales smoothly from 1x to 2x based on your response time.

average.explanation: The system is centered around 100 as the average score, following standard IQ distribution patterns.

standard-deviation.explanation: A standard deviation of 15 points means that about 68% of users fall within 85-115, 95% within 70-130, and 99.7% within 55-145.

titans.explanation: The legendary Titans Society represents the pinnacle of achievement. Members consistently demonstrate exceptional understanding and quick thinking.

mavericks.explanation: Mavericks are elite performers who regularly showcase outstanding comprehension and rapid information processing.

elites.explanation: The Elites demonstrate above-average performance and consistent growth.

strivers.explanation: Strivers represent the core of our community, showing steady progress and reliable performance.

explorers.explanation: Everyone begins as an Explorer, equipped with tools and guidance to learn and improve.

trigger.explanation: The Quin Boost activates after completing 5 quizzes in sequence, rewarding sustained engagement.

reward.explanation: Your 6th quiz receives a powerful 1.5x multiplier to your RQM score.

trigger.explanation: A week of consistent daily activity unlocks the Streak Surge.

reward.text: Reward: 1.5x RQM for the entire day
reward.explanation: Enjoy a 1.5x multiplier on all quizzes for a full day!

max-multiplier.explanation: The system caps total multipliers at 2x to maintain balance.

requirements.text: Requires active Quin Boost + Streak Surge + Category boost
requirements.explanation: Achieving maximum multiplication requires careful timing and activation of multiple boost types.

per-attempt.explanation: Each quiz calculates its multiplier independently.

registration.explanation: Five-day registration period allows players to prepare and strategize.

competition.explanation: Intense weekend competition tests your knowledge and speed.

duration.explanation: A month-long championship that tests consistency and endurance.

rewards.explanation: Substantial rewards await the highest performers.

refresh.text: Automatic refresh on 1st of every month
refresh.explanation: The leaderboard undergoes a complete refresh at the start of each month, ensuring fair competition and fresh opportunities for all players.

archival.explanation: Your performance from the previous month is preserved in an accessible archive, allowing you to track your progress over time.

hall-of-champions.explanation: Top performers from the previous month are honored in the Hall of Champions, where their names are displayed as recognition of their outstanding achievement.

fresh-start.explanation: Each month represents a new opportunity to climb the ranks.

equal-opportunities.explanation: Monthly resets ensure that new and existing players alike have equal chances to achieve top rankings.

dynamic-ranking.explanation: Rankings are calculated based on your current month's performance metrics.
